
# **Tipping Study - pt.2 Clean & prep data**

---

Setup
---

#### Workspace

```{r}
if (!requireNamespace("here")) install.packages("here")
source(here::here("r", "utilities", "workspace.r"))

library(data.table)
library(gsignal)
```

#### Data

```{r}
load(here::here("data", "proc", "01_out.rdata"))
```

#### Drop frames prior to go-signal
```{r}
# dt <- dt[reaching == TRUE]
dt[, frame := seq_len(.N), by = .(participant, trial_num, block_num)]
```


Smooth
---

Data dual-passed through a 4th order dual low-pass Butterworth filter
A 6 Hz cutoff was chosen because a biomechanist said so.

#### Run butterworth

```{r}
filt_order <- 4
samp <- 120
cutoff <- 6
nyq <- samp / 2
wn <- cutoff / nyq

buttbutt <- butter(
  n = filt_order, w = wn, type = "low", output = "Sos"
)

to_smooth <- grep("_x$|_y$|_z$", colnames(dt), value = TRUE)

grp_n <- uniqueN(dt, c("trial_num", "block_num", "participant"))

# TODO: learn to do in parallel
for (col in to_smooth) {
  # can take a while
  pb <- txtProgressBar(min = 0, max = grp_n, style = 3)
  dt[,
    (paste0(col, "_smooth")) := {
      setTxtProgressBar(pb, .GRP)
      gsignal::filtfilt(buttbutt, get(col))
    },
    by = .(participant, trial_num, block_num)
  ]
}
```


###### Drop rough data

```{r}
# drop raw
raw_cols <- grep("_x$|_y$|_z$", colnames(dt), value = TRUE)
dt[, (raw_cols) := NULL]

# drop _smooth from smoothed
smoothed_cols <- grep("_smooth$", colnames(dt), value = TRUE)
setnames(dt, smoothed_cols, gsub("_smooth", "", smoothed_cols))
```

###### Get hand position

Treating the avg to represent hand pos

```{r}
invisible(
  lapply(
    c("x", "y", "z"),
    \(axis) {
      cols <- grep(paste0("_", axis, "$"), colnames(dt), value = TRUE)
      dt[, paste0("hand_", axis) := rowMeans(.SD), .SDcols = cols]
    }
  )
)
```

###### Translate

Origin is wherever they started

```{r}
hand_cols <- grep("_(x|y|z)", colnames(dt))

dt[, (hand_cols) := lapply(.SD, \(axis) axis <- axis - axis[1]),
  by = .(participant, trial_num, block_num),
  .SDcols = hand_cols
]

# drop marker cols
dt[, (grep("^m\\d", colnames(dt))) := NULL] # succinct af
```
---

```{r}
save(dt, file = here::here("data", "proc", "02_out.rdata"))
```
